caption: Figure 4.6 Results of monohybrid cross in the plant Snapdragon, where one allele is incompletely dominant over the other allele
note: Caption is printed on four lines and is joined here with single spaces. 'F₁ generation' and 'F₂ generation' are printed with a subscript digit (plain-text form: 'F1 generation', 'F2 generation'). The two lower 'Gametes' labels each carry a printed sex symbol above the word, transcribed here as '♀ Gametes' (left) and '♂ Gametes' (right); the upper 'Gametes' label has no symbol. F₂ Punnett diamond reads 'RR' (top), 'Rr' (left), 'Rr' (right), 'rr' (bottom); its gamete circles are R (upper) and r (lower) on each side. The ratio lines are printed with the figures aligned under the terms; the alignment spacing is not reproduced.
